card.name: Scattered words in quirky science and news prose
card.fires_on: No single word or setting; it fires on assorted words (the, created, a comma, a period, syndrome, unusual, questions) in general web prose, mostly about odd or surprising studies and claims.

modes.label: Words before a figure or study
modes.description: A small word like 'the' or a space sits just before a cited paper or year.
modes.example: One of<< the>> most commonly cited figures is from a paper

modes.label: Words describing something odd
modes.description: An adjective or noun that frames a strange or novel idea, such as unusual, silly or innovative.
modes.example: proposes an<< unusual>> way to help the victim of a stroke

card.plain: It reacts to a mix of ordinary words in quirky news and science writing, with no pattern a clinician could rely on.
